name: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
rule: For safety, range.end must be valid and properly aligned for T and point one past the last element, such that the offset from the end to the start pointer is the length of the slice.
api: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : core::ops::range::Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied grammar: `range.start` and `range.end` have no pointee-memory or pointer-address observations. Their `$mem` fields describe pointer-slot storage, not the pointed-to locations.
